name: vision_detector
title: A YOLO-shaped single-stage detector: anchors, ragged collate, class-wise NMS and a mAP pass, written correctly
origin: domain-vision round 1: the shape of torchvision's detection reference and of every anchor-based detector repo - a geometry module, a Dataset with a custom collate, a backbone/FPN/head model, and a multi-task loss module

forbidden.why: DetectionLoss.forward sums the per-image classification terms into `total` and RETURNS the sum, which the caller back-propagates at train.py:72 - the graph has to stay alive until then, so this is the documented 'intentional multi-step accumulation for a single backward()' guard, not a leak
same statement group: the per-image regression term is added into the same returned total
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the two evaluation loaders are built with shuffle=False
every loader is built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard in train.py
the random horizontal flip is gated on self.train, and the val/test datasets are constructed with train=False
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() in every batch
the order is backward -> clip -> step
the only no_grad region is postprocess(), which contains no backward()
clip_grad_norm_ sits between loss.backward() and optimizer.step()
evaluate_map() calls model.eval() first
evaluate_map() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the classification branch returns raw logits and the loss is BCEWithLogitsLoss, which is the correct pairing
to_device() moves the images and every target field before the forward
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy and torch, and main() calls it first
the three splits are three annotation files; nothing is split at run time
every nn.Module subclass calls super().__init__()
the three detection heads live in an nn.ModuleList and the lateral/smooth convolutions in two more
torch.save writes model.state_dict() and torch.load passes map_location= and weights_only=True

gaps.what: MLV205 fires twice on this correct program (train.py:54 and train.py:58) - the documented guard 'suppressed when .backward() is called on the accumulator itself' does not cover a loss nn.Module that accumulates sub-losses and returns the sum
gaps.evidence: the two forbidden labels above; minimal repro in the report
